cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: I Know the Procedure
cards.instruction: Perform investigative confidence while quietly using each response to discover what the questions, clues, and next steps should be.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'll investigate the missing raffle tin. Naturally, we begin with access.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cleaner has the only cupboard key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. As expected. Where does our keyholder go after cleaning?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Reception. But the tin never went in the cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, we've eliminated that location. Confirm where you last saw it; I'll establish our next search area.

mechanism: A commands the investigation while borrowing each answer to invent the next supposedly expected step.
confusable: Unlike systematic inquiry genuinely planned, A retrofits a mistaken lead as an intended elimination after B corrects it.
comparison: A missing raffle tin and irrelevant cupboard lead differ from a loose door hinge and borrowed repair method.
seedUse: The seed already appoints A investigator and directs confirmation/search; S01 supports the asserted investigative hierarchy.
